name: @w6w-apps/timelinesai
description: Send WhatsApp messages and notes, manage chats, labels, files, reactions and webhooks, and read workspace quota through TimelinesAI.

w6w.longDescription:
TimelinesAI puts a team's WhatsApp numbers into a shared inbox with a REST API. A number is an ordinary WhatsApp account connected to the workspace, so a workflow can message any phone, reply inside an existing chat or group, and keep CRM-style state on the conversation: labels, an assigned teammate, an open/closed flag, internal notes and a read state.

This app covers the Public API: sending a message to a phone number, a chat id or a WhatsApp JID (with an uploaded file, an attachment template, or as a reply); reading chats, message history, a single message, its delivery history and its reactions; adding internal notes; adding or replacing a chat's labels; updating a chat (rename, assign, close, mark read); uploading a file from a URL and listing, fetching or deleting uploaded files; managing the webhook subscriptions that push new messages, new chats, assignments, calls and account events to your endpoint; and reading the workspace, its connected WhatsApp accounts and its teammates.

Every path, verb and field was read on 2026-10-06 from TimelinesAI's own reference at timelines.ai/docs, whose pages embed a full OpenAPI document. Sends spend message credits and are rate limited per IP; the WhatsApp Business Platform (WABA) endpoints are a separate surface and are not covered. See the README for what was left out and the quirks that shaped the design.
